reuse.why: Uses the shared getMonthBudgetCategories selection, averageToBudgetAmount sign helper, getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator/undoable wiring.

duplication.why: No rule is copied; only the usual fetch-categories/batch/loop/setBudget skeleton that every month-wide action in this file repeats.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts with its siblings and is registered in budget/app.ts like the other budget methods.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and one test.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with its siblings; borrowing the 'average' selection key and the averageToBudgetAmount name for a non-average action is slightly misleading but harmless.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection and sign conversion go through the existing month-action-categories helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is re-expressed; the shared selection and sign helpers are called directly.
